settings.question: What does T200, T250 and T300 mean?
settings.answer: It is the thread count: threads woven into one square inch. Higher counts feel smoother and silkier; T200 is crisp and breathable, T300 is our softest sateen.

settings.question: How should I wash my sheets?
settings.answer: Wash cool (30–40°C) with mild detergent, tumble dry low and iron warm. Avoid bleach to keep colours rich.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: 2–3 working days in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad, 3–5 days elsewhere. Cash on delivery is available nationwide.

settings.question: Can I exchange a product?
settings.answer: Yes, unused products in original packing can be exchanged within 7 days.
